title: [Hiatus] AXELotls
description: (This project may not get further updates) It seems the axolotls have taken a note about Organization XIII and now share Axel's voice.
body: Axolotls share little in common with Organization XIII member Axel, minus the name. But what if they shared his voice? This pack replaces all the axolotl sound effects with voice clips of Axel from KH II and III. Simple as that, really. Got it memorized?
